nodes.label: Architecture Notes — Multitenant Cleaning Management SaaS
Hardcoded Gmail Credential in TenantMailConfig
nodes.rationale: Fallback JavaMailSenderImpl bean with a plaintext Gmail address/app password committed to git; flagged for rotation regardless of 'dev default' framing.

nodes.label: Broken AES-GCM Encryption (zero nonce)
nodes.rationale: AesEncryptionDeCryption uses a fixed all-zero nonce/IV for every encryption of tenant SMTP passwords, breaking AES-GCM's forgery/plaintext-recovery guarantee; needs a random IV persisted with the ciphertext.

nodes.label: No Method-Level Authorization Anywhere
nodes.rationale: Restrictions are hand-written if(isClient()) checks duplicated across ~15 controllers instead of @PreAuthorize/@Secured, leaving several sensitive endpoints completely unguarded.

nodes.label: Likely Login-Breaking {bcrypt} Prefix Bug
nodes.rationale: SuperAdminUser.password has a manually prepended '{bcrypt}' prefix but the wired encoder is a plain BCryptPasswordEncoder, not DelegatingPasswordEncoder — worth verifying at runtime.

nodes.label: Likely Broken Admin Queries (AdminUserMapper)
nodes.rationale: AdminUserMapper.getAllUsers/findById filter on user_type_enum values that never match INTERNAL admin users; getActiveRole queries the wrong table — reads like copy-pasted tenant-side SQL.

nodes.label: WebSocket Tenant-Trust Inconsistency
nodes.rationale: TenantChannelInterceptor accepts a client-supplied x-tenant-id and would feed it into raw SET search_path SQL if useSetSearchPath were ever flipped true — currently inert but a landmine, unlike ChatController which resolves the header through TenantDomainRepository first.

nodes.label: Unsanitized Upload Filename (ChatMessageController)
nodes.rationale: uploadChatImage writes System.currentTimeMillis()+originalFilename to disk without sanitizing it (path traversal risk), unlike ImageStampUtil which does sanitize.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Identification via Origin String
nodes.rationale: The tenant Axios client sends x-tenant-id: window.location.origin (not a real ID) as the entire client-side tenancy mechanism, depending entirely on backend hostname matching being correct/exclusive.

nodes.label: Incident Wizard setIncidentId/setDocumentId Swap Bug
nodes.rationale: Incident.tsx step 4's IncidentDocuments success handler calls setIncidentId(id) instead of setDocumentId(id), corrupting data for every injury-type incident report.

nodes.label: Money Stored as Double (Precision Inconsistency)
nodes.rationale: Invoice/InvoiceLineItem/FinanceLedgerEntry/BankTransaction use Double while StaffPayroll/SupervisorSalary/SiteRole correctly use BigDecimal — inconsistent currency precision within the same domain.

nodes.label: GST/Tax Rate Multiple Sources of Truth
nodes.rationale: FinanceUtils.GST_RATE hardcodes 10%, FinanceServiceImpl.reconcile independently hardcodes /1.1, InvoicePdfServiceImpl reads the tenant's real tax rate, and ExpenseServiceImpl never computes GST — a tenant with a non-default rate gets silently wrong reconciliation numbers.

nodes.label: Two Competing Tenant Signup Pages
nodes.rationale: SignUpPage.tsx and Register.tsx (the latter's Zod schema confusingly named superAdminLoginSchema) post to different endpoints; unclear which one the router actually serves at /signup.

nodes.label: Full Feature Gap Analysis: Cord Cleaning vs Xero/QuickBooks
B. Tax & Compliance
nodes.rationale: GST/tax on invoices marked PARTIAL: flat 10% only (FinanceUtils.DEFAULT_GST_RATE); a second, conflicting hardcoded GST calc exists in FinanceServiceImpl.reconcile — a live data-integrity bug.

nodes.label: Bug #1: Site → Maps Tab Crash
nodes.rationale: Map.tsx still reads an old URL parameter the site page no longer has, so site data is always empty and the tab crashes for everyone.

nodes.label: Bug #2: Sidebar Infinite Re-render Loop
nodes.rationale: SidebarTenants.tsx re-renders menus even when nothing changed, burning CPU/battery and sticking the phone layout on the loading screen.

nodes.label: Bug #3: Invoice Multi-Currency Save Bug
nodes.rationale: Changing only currency/exchange-rate/tracking tag can silently save previous values because the save handler's dependency list doesn't watch those fields — from this week's multi-currency work.

nodes.label: Bug #4: Client Company Type Shows Blank
nodes.rationale: The Client Details edit form fills in before the options load, so Company Type shows blank and saving loses the type.

nodes.label: Bug #5: Chat WebSocket Tenant-Trust Bug
nodes.rationale: The chat websocket uses the browser-supplied website address as the database schema, so joining a channel isn't checked against the user's own business — possible cross-business chat access.

nodes.label: Navigation & Access Gaps (#29-31)
nodes.rationale: Five finished pages have no menu entry for anyone; Staff and Client menus are missing links to pages already built for them.

nodes.label: Suggestion #39: Role-Based Menus
nodes.rationale: Build proper Staff and Client menus from pages that already exist — the biggest usability win for the least work.

nodes.label: Suggestion #47: WebSocket & Header Hardening
nodes.rationale: Derive the business from the login token everywhere, never from a browser-supplied header.

nodes.label: Suggestion #45: Nightly Smoke Test
nodes.rationale: Turn the audit's read-only crawler into an automatic pre-deploy check so crashes like #1 never reach users.

nodes.label: Fixed Assets Page (screen-size findings #18, #28d)
nodes.rationale: A working 'Fixed Assets' table/page exists and was crawled at all screen sizes, though it has layout overflow bugs.

nodes.label: Phase 0: Stabilize the Foundation
nodes.rationale: No new user-facing features — entirely risk reduction: fix the GST double-calculation bug, fix the bank-statement Excel import stub, write regression tests, and stand up module-flag scaffolding before any later phase touches schema.

nodes.label: Phase 1: Core Accounting Backbone
nodes.rationale: New Chart of Accounts and double-entry Journal Entry tables sit alongside the existing single-entry FinanceLedgerEntry; additive-only so nothing existing changes underneath the user.

nodes.label: Phase 2: Financial Statements & Tax Compliance
nodes.rationale: Read-only reporting layer on top of Phase 1's GL — zero risk to existing screens since these are entirely new pages.

nodes.label: Phase 3: Accounts Payable
nodes.rationale: A net-new module that does not touch the existing Invoice (AR) module at all.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Revenue Capture & Invoicing Polish
nodes.rationale: Every item is an addition to the existing Invoice/Quote screens — the current create/send/PDF/payment-tracking flow is only extended, not modified.

nodes.label: Phase 5: Banking Modernization
nodes.rationale: The existing manual CSV upload keeps working unchanged; live feeds are a new, additional data source into the same reconciliation screen.

nodes.label: Phase 6: Payroll Compliance
nodes.rationale: Highest regulatory risk and longest external lead time — start Single Touch Payroll ATO registration early since it runs on a government timeline outside engineering's control.

nodes.label: Phase 7: Fixed Assets & Inventory
nodes.rationale: Lowest urgency for a services business — confirm actual demand before committing engineering time.

nodes.label: Phase 8: Platform, Access & Ecosystem
nodes.rationale: A wrap-up pass that makes the modules built in Phases 1-7 properly accessible and connectable without changing how any of them work internally.
